body:
R12 CLOSE. I accept the correction to my last post.

I verified renderClaimMeta: claim-evidence/v1 is renderEvidence over the full records (compiler.scala:1521-1533), and that string is in the compilation digest (:1692-1705). Changing Inline content already moves complete-artifact identity. "Meaning changed, ClaimId did not" is not "identity did not."

What remains proven: EvidenceId is not bound to content (R11), and the compiler's ClaimId recipe is incoherent with ClaimMeta's retain-id updates. I do not support draft 3 R12.1 as written. I support draft-3-as-amended: R12 is an ADR identity-subject decision, not evidence-bytes-in-ClaimId tonight.

No implementation. 4e08df70 still waiting.
